metadata.title: Identifying Star Streams in the Milky Way Halo

notes: No eligible individual stars are identified. The paper analyzes statistical samples and stellar populations in the HVS survey and the Sagittarius stream, not named stars. Its HVS sample explicitly excludes unbound hypervelocity stars: “The upper limit on the velocity removes unbound HVSs” (T:p4-b4). Sagittarius-stream members are tidal-debris stars and are not identified as Galactic unbound candidates; no specific star is retained as such a candidate or studied as a prior Galactic-unbound candidate.
